info.description: REST API for the gatra-budget Go + React starter kit
info.title: gatra-budget Backend API

get.description: Retrieve all areas with optional city_id filter, search, and pagination

post.description: Authenticate user and return JWT token

200.description: Login successful with token and user data

get.description: Retrieve budget items, optionally filtered by project or parent

parameters.description: Filter by parent budget item ID (UUID)
parameters.name: parent_budget_id

200.description: List of budget items with pagination

post.description: Creates a parent budget item; "monthly" items also create evenly-split monthly children

404.description: Project or cost type not found

get.summary: Get a budget item by ID

put.description: Updates a parent budget item. Monthly items are re-synced: children are destroyed and rebuilt against the new total. Non-parent rows are updated directly.

delete.description: Deletes a budget item. Deleting a parent cascades to its monthly children.

get.description: Retrieve all cities with optional province_id filter, search, and pagination
Retrieve all clients with optional search and pagination
Retrieve all contract types with optional search and pagination

200.description: List of contract types with pagination

get.summary: Get a contract type by ID

get.description: Retrieve all cost types with optional search and pagination

200.description: List of cost types with pagination

get.summary: Get a cost type by ID

get.description: Retrieve all countries with optional search and pagination
Retrieve a single country by its UUID

put.description: Update an existing country by ID

get.description: Get authenticated user's profile information

put.description: Update authenticated user's profile information (full_name and password)

get.description: Get all addresses belonging to the authenticated user

post.summary: Create a new address for the current user

get.summary: Get a specific address of the current user

put.summary: Update an address of the current user

delete.summary: Delete an address of the current user

get.description: Retrieve all projects with optional status filter, search, and pagination

parameters.description: Filter by status (Active, Pending, Non Aktif)
parameters.name: status_kontrak

get.description: Non-sensitive per-month allocated (budget item children) vs realized (transactions) totals
get.summary: Get a project's monthly budget-vs-actual trend

get.description: Non-sensitive count of this project's transactions by SLA status
get.summary: Get a project's payment SLA breakdown

get.description: Retrieve all provinces with optional country_id filter, search, and pagination
Realized spend and management fee per project per month, with grand totals. Computed server-side only; the client renders this as-is.
get.summary: Get the management fee breakdown by project and month (admin only)

200.description: Rows by project and month, plus totals

get.description: Per-project contract value, realized total, remaining budget, absorption (alert at 80%), and management-fee-style profit margin
get.summary: Get remaining budget and profit margin for every project (admin only)

parameters.description: Filter by status (Active, Pending, Non Aktif)
parameters.name: status_kontrak

get.summary: Get remaining budget and profit margin for one project (admin only)

get.description: Retrieve transactions, optionally filtered by project or cost type, with pagination

post.description: Creates a transaction; bulan_realisasi and the management-fee fields are computed server-side from the project's fee rate

404.description: Project or cost type not found

post.description: Upload image or file for a specific resource and field

delete.description: Delete uploaded file and set database field to null

get.description: Retrieve all users with pagination and optional search filter. Only accessible by admin users.

post.description: Create a new user with email, password, full name, and role. Only accessible by admin users.

get.description: Retrieve a specific user by their ID. Only accessible by admin users.

put.description: Update user information including email, password, full name, and role. Only accessible by admin users.

delete.description: Delete a user by their ID. Only accessible by admin users.

get.description: Get all addresses for a specific user. Only accessible by admin users.
get.summary: Get addresses by user ID (Admin only)

BearerAuth.description: Type "Bearer" followed by a space and JWT token.
BearerAuth.name: Authorization
